verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail advertises Zapier connectivity (5000+ apps) and a direct API for workflow control, supporting event-driven automation, but no evidence specifies webhooks or named triggers like 'new mail' or 'scan complete,' and API documentation probes (OpenAPI, docs.md, llms.txt) all 404'd. missing for 10: explicit webhook events, documented Zapier trigger names, and accessible API/OpenAPI reference confirming trigger-based (not polling) automation.
